title: Inverse Finance — Curve/Yearn Oracle Manipulation DOLA Over-Borrowing Analysis
root_cause: The collateral pricing function `_getCollateralPrice()` directly used Curve's `get_virtual_price()`, allowing a temporarily inflated AMM internal value caused by a large swap to be recognized as collateral value, enabling excessive DOLA borrowing
steps: ⚡ WBTC ratio in pool spikes → virtual_price rises
⚡ virtual_price inflated → collateral value larger than actual
